reports.summary: This Rockman Xover revival captures an impressive breadth of the original mobile action-RPG's systems—auto-scrolling platforming with 3-tier piercing Charge Shots and 6-beam Giga Crush, turn-based Boss and 4-Player Master Raid battles with C.Shot gauges and Battle Memory skill cut-ins, the geometric Bonus Line deck matrix, 3x3 Map Parts, Gacha, and Bulk Cheer. However, a high-severity game-loop throttling bug in multi-tab/multiplayer mode (`requestAnimationFrame` with a 0.1s elapsed clamp and no background timer fallback) causes Player 0's simulation to stall when Player 1's tab is open, and multiplayer co-op peers who haven't started running hover frozen in mid-air behind the player. Fixing the background tick loop, peer state rendering, and inert enemy projectiles will make the game much smoother and more exciting.
best: Core auto-runner action loop with 3-tier auto-charging Pierce Shots (Blue 1-hit, Yellow 2-pierce, Red/Pink 3-pierce) and the 6-beam full-screen Giga Crush feels immediately rewarding in the first minute.

Authentic Rockman Xover HUD and systems architecture: the 28-segment vertical stage/HP bars, top-center pickup banners, Battle Memory geometric Bonus Line deck matrix, 3x3 Map Parts grid, 4-Player Master Boss Raid, Battle Tower, and Bulk Cheer (一括応援) are all thoughtfully integrated and accessible from the top bar.
WebAudio synthesized sound effects and BGM cover every action (jump, tiered charge ticks, pierce shots, Giga Crush, card drops, skill cut-ins, and cheers).

issues.detail: When opening the game with 2 players (`open_game({players: 2})`), Player 0's tab is in the background behind Player 1's tab. Because `public/js/game.js` relies solely on `requestAnimationFrame(frame)` and clamps `elapsed = Math.min(0.1, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)`, Chromium's background-tab rAF throttling causes Player 0's simulation to advance by only ~0.1s per screenshot/input instead of running in real time. Additionally, in `keydown`, `if (game.titleOverlay) { dismissTitleAndStart(); }` does not `return;` (unlike `pointerdown`), nor does it immediately render a frame, so tapping Space on the title screen leaves the title overlay drawn on screen while `window.State.titleOverlay` becomes `false`. Add a `setInterval` fallback ticker when rAF is throttled and `return` after `dismissTitleAndStart()` on `keydown`.
issues.title: Simulation loop stalls in background tab during 2-player sessions and first keydown doesn't cleanly clear title overlay
issues.evidence: Called `open_game({players: 2})`, tapped `Space` on Player 0 (`window.State.titleOverlay` became `false` while the screenshot still showed the title modal), and later ran 4.8s of `input` steps at `vx: 195` where `window.State.x` only advanced from `1645` to `1684` (39px = 0.2s) and stayed frozen at `1684` on `look`.

Throughout Player 1's run from `x = 270` to `x = 1684`, `Player2` remained suspended in mid-air at `y = 370` on the left side of the screen because Player 2's initial `py` during `warpTimer` is `GROUND_Y - 160 = 370`.
issues.detail: In `public/js/stage.js` (`renderStage`), multiplayer peers are always drawn at `peerX = PLAYER_SCREEN_X - 52 * peerIdx` and `peerY = ps.py` with `running: true`, regardless of whether that peer is still on the title screen (`py = 370` mid-warp) or on another menu tab. When Player 2 has not yet dismissed the title overlay, their character sprite hovers frozen in mid-air at `y = 370` behind Player 1 across the entire stage. Sync `titleOverlay` / `onGround` state or clamp inactive peers to `GROUND_Y` (or only render peers currently in `stage` mode).
issues.title: Inactive or menu-bound multiplayer peers float frozen in mid-air behind the runner in stages

issues.evidence: Played through World 1-1 (`x = 270` to `1684`) and inspected `public/js/stage.js`: `enemyBullets` is never referenced after initialization on line 48, and `health` remained `3789/3789` even after `{"source":"batton","t":42511,"type":"hit"}`.
issues.detail: In `public/js/stage.js`, `createStageState` creates `enemyBullets: []` and gives every `"cannon"`, `"rex"`, and `"batton"` enemy a `shootTimer` property, but `updateStage` and `renderStage` never update `shootTimer` or spawn/render `enemyBullets`. Moreover, hitting an enemy or spike hazard only sets `hurtTimer = 0.7` without reducing HP, combo, or charge/Giga gauge, so there is no threat or reason to dodge hazards once Giga Crush is charged.
issues.title: Stage enemies never fire projectiles despite `shootTimer`/`enemyBullets` state, and hits carry no penalty
Floating pickup texts stack on top of each other and the player nametag
issues.evidence: At `x = 1645` and `x = 1684`, picking up 3 coins in a row produced overlapping yellow text directly over `Player1`'s nametag.
issues.detail: When multiple Zenny coins, EP capsules, or cards are magnet-pulled together, `st.floatTexts` all spawn at `{ x: PLAYER_SCREEN_X, y: st.py - 56 }`. Because `floatTexts` only drift upward at `36 px/s`, consecutive pickups stack directly on top of each other and over the `Player1` label, making the numbers unreadable (`+102Z`, `+98Z`, `+94Z` rendered as a solid yellow blob). Offset new floating texts based on active nearby `floatTexts` so each popup is legible.

reports.summary: This Rockman Xover revival captures a surprising amount of the lost mobile RPG's full loop: auto-scrolling action stages with 3-tier auto-charging pierce shots and Giga Crush, turn-based Maverick boss battles with 50-turn limits, C.Shot Lv.0-5 gauges, Battle Memory skill cut-ins, geometric Bonus Line deck building across unlockable OVER armors, gacha/card enhancement, Battle Tower, 1v1 Arena, and 4-player co-op Master Raids with shared boss HP. However, two high-severity issues hold back stage play and multiplayer: (1) peers who are still on the initial title overlay (or on other menu tabs) broadcast a frozen warp-in height (py=370) or menu height (py=540) and render stuck floating in mid-air following Player 1 across the stage; and (2) in Action Stages, player HP is never reduced when hit (window.State.health stays frozen at maxHealth), the far-left 28-segment HP bar from the original game is mistakenly wired to stage scroll distance instead of health, and enemy shooting (enemyBullets/shootTimer) is left unimplemented in the update loop.
best: Cohesive RPG loop connecting Action Stages, Turn-Based Boss Battles, 4-Player Co-op Master Boss Raids (with live WebSocket HP syncing via raidHit), Battle Tower, and 1v1 Arena PvP all accessible from a clean top navigation bar.

Battle Memory Deck & Bonus Line Matrix (public/js/deck.js): geometric card slot layouts for OVER-1 through OVER-10 with glowing Bonus Lines when matching card border colors or White core cards (+14% stats per line) within the player's CST cap.

Auto-charging Buster and Pierce mechanic in Action Stages (Blue -> Yellow 2x Pierce -> Red/Pink 3x Pierce) that rewards lining up multi-kills to rapidly fill the Giga Crush gauge, paired with responsive coyote-time/jump-buffer platforming and synthesized WebAudio SFX/BGM.

Authentic Boss Battle HUD and mechanics (public/js/boss.js): 50-turn counter, top-right SKIP button, C.Shot Lv.0-5 gauge, start-of-turn Battle Memory skill cut-ins, Armor Part drops (5 parts per OVER armor), and the 100-Crest Awakening Continue rematch system.

issues.title: Peers on title overlay or other menus render stuck floating in mid-air at y=370 following the player across the stage
issues.detail: In public/js/game.js (frame), syncWindowAndNetworkState() broadcasts the local player's state even while titleOverlay is true, whereas StageMode.updateStage() is paused while titleOverlay is true. Because st.py initializes to GROUND_Y - 160 (370) for the 0.75s warp-in beam, any peer who is still on the title overlay (or whose background tab hasn't ticked past warpTimer) broadcasts py: 370 forever. StageMode.renderStage() (lines 697-718) then draws those peers stuck floating in mid-air at y=370 in a jumping pose, locked to a fixed horizontal offset (PLAYER_SCREEN_X - 52 * peerIdx) that drags them along with Player 1's camera. Furthermore, when a peer switches to non-stage screens (deck, gacha, world, boss), syncWindowAndNetworkState sends py: 540 (10px below GROUND_Y=530) and renderStage still draws them in the stage. Only peers with active stage state (not on titleOverlay and on screen === 'stage') should be rendered as stage runners, and their y position should clamp/default cleanly.
issues.evidence: Opened game with 3 players and played Stage 1-1 on Player 0 (x=270 -> x=1684); screenshots on Player 0 and Player 1 show Player2 and Player3 floating mid-air at y=370 with jumping poses following Player 1 across the stage.

During Stage 1-1 on Player 0, __events recorded 7 hits (cannon, rex, hazard at t=43856..113170), yet window.State.health remained 3789/3789 while the left bar drained purely from scrollX distance. Compare with Footage A 00:44-01:26 and A 16:32-16:33.
issues.detail: In the original Rockman Xover (Video A 00:44-01:26, 05:27-05:57, 16:32-16:33), the far-left 28-segment yellow-orange vertical bar is OVER-1's HP bar, which stays full during clean runs and drops by 2 segments when OVER-1 takes damage (accompanied by a yellow electric shock flinch and resetting OVER-1's charge aura). In public/js/stage.js (lines 783-795), the left vertical bar is instead wired to stage distance remaining (1 - st.scrollX / st.maxDist), st has no HP tracking at all, getting hit by enemies/hazards (lines 515-536) does not reduce HP or reset st.chargeTime/st.chargeTier, and public/js/game.js (line 932) hardcodes window.State.health to stats.hp (3789) during stage mode regardless of hits taken.
issues.title: Action Stage player HP is never reduced on hit, charge aura doesn't reset on hit, and left HP bar is wired to stage distance instead of HP

issues.evidence: Inspected public/js/stage.js lines 49, 97, 111, 129 and observed enemies in Stage 1-1 never firing projectiles. Compare with Footage A 16:32-16:33.
issues.title: Enemy projectiles and turret hazards (enemyBullets / shootTimer) are defined in StageMode but never updated or rendered
issues.detail: In public/js/stage.js, createStageState() initializes enemyBullets: [] (line 49) and populateStageLayout() assigns shootTimer to every ground and aerial enemy (lines 97, 111, 129), but updateStage() and renderStage() never update shootTimer or spawn/render enemyBullets. In the original game (Video A 00:52, 16:32-16:33), upper-catwalk cannons and enemies fire projectiles / drop electric hazards that test the player's positioning and jumping.

issues.evidence: Played Stage 1-1 with 3 players in room tmvol1fvm; peer sprites trail behind Player 1 but never fire bullets or interact with stage enemies.
issues.title: Co-op squadmates in Action Stages are purely cosmetic and do not fire shots or interact with stage enemies
issues.detail: While 4-Player Master Boss Raids sync shared boss damage across players via raidHit messages, in Action Stages co-op peers in the room are purely visual ghosts trailing behind the player (public/js/stage.js lines 697-718). When peers fire shots (ps.shooting / net messages), they do not spawn co-op projectiles or help destroy stage enemies/hazards. Letting room allies visibly fire shots or grant a live Squad Link bonus during stages would make co-op stage runs feel genuinely interactive.

issues.evidence: Triggered Giga Crush (KeyC) and Map Part pickups in Stage 1-1 and inspected boss.js renderBoss(). Compare with Footage A 01:17-01:19, 05:34-05:35, 10:17-10:46.
issues.detail: Several signature visual feedback moments from the original footage are simplified to plain rectangles or text banners: (1) In Video A 01:17-01:19 and 14:43, Giga Crush triggers 6 circular white/yellow energy explosions in a 3x2 grid across the screen with 1Hit!!..6Hit!! popups, whereas stage.js (lines 222-230, 756-766) draws 6 vertical rectangles; (2) In Video A 05:34-05:35 and 06:33, picking up a Battle Memory card or Map Part briefly flashes a visual card/3x3 puzzle piece overlay, whereas stage.js only shows a text banner; (3) In Boss Battles (Video A 02:27, 10:17-10:46, 18:11), OVER-1 and the Boss remain stationary when firing instead of lunging/dashing during attack animations.
issues.title: Giga Crush 3x2 explosions, Map/Card pickup popups, and Boss lunge animations lack original visual flair

issues.detail: In public/js/stage.js (lines 904, 922, 940, 958), the Stage Clear modal header says 'CHEER FOR +60 ZENNY', the individual peer buttons say 'CHEER +25Z', and the Bulk Cheer button says 'BULK CHEER (+75Z)'. Additionally, the Next Action button says '▶ RUN AGAIN (+25%)' even though applyStageRunRewards() in public/js/game.js (line 369) actually adds +40% stage progress per run.
issues.title: Mismatched reward numbers on Stage Clear UI buttons (+25% vs actual +40% progress, +60Z vs +25Z/+75Z cheer)
issues.evidence: Inspected public/js/stage.js lines 904-960 and public/js/game.js line 369.
